SELECT a.attendance_id, e.emp_id, e.emp_name, d.dep_name AS department_name, a.work_date, a.check_in_time,
CASE WHEN TIME(a.check_in_time) > '09:00:00' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_late,
a.work_date AS late_date, TIMEDIFF(a.check_in_time, '09:00:00') AS late_duration,
r.reason_content AS late_reason, r.status
FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id LEFT JOIN reason r ON a.attendance_id = r.attendance_id
WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND TIME(a.check_in_time) > '09:00:00'

SELECT a.work_date, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.emp_id, e.emp_name FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY a.work_date

SELECT a.attendance_id, a.emp_id, a.work_date, a.check_in_time, a.check_out_time, a.work_days, a.work_hours, a.night_work_hour, a.is_late, a.late_reason, a.absence_reason, a.created_at, a.updated_at, e.emp_name, d.dep_name AS department_name FROM attendance a JOIN employee e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.emp_id = #{empId} AND a.work_date = #{date}
SELECT leave_id, emp_id, start_date, end_date, leave_type, reason, is_approved FROM leave WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1) FROM leave WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND is_approved = 1
SELECT work_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY work_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE (emp_id, check_in_time, check_out_time, work_type, absence_reason) VALUES (#{empId}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{workType}, #{absenceReason})
